text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I'm working as usual when Super<n>Creek excitedly
places a flyer on my<n>desk.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: It's for a free one-day pottery class.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
They're holding an event at the art<n>museum. It
looks like you get to make<n>your own bowls and
teacups.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Doesn't it sound like a lot of fun?<n>Why don't you
come with me?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Great! Since I don't have anything<n>else to do today,
let's get going! ♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: What are you thinking of making?
choice_data_list: Maybe something we can use for training?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Gosh! Hehe, I wonder if you can<n>really make
something like that out of<n>clay...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
You've always got training on your<n>mind, haven't
you?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I absolutely adore how dedicated you<n>are.
choice_data_list: What are you going to make?
What are you going to make?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, good question. A teacup or a<n>vase might be
nice...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
But you have to carefully consider the<n>thickness of
things like teacups, or<n>they might end up being too
heavy to<n>use...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
And vases are big, so you have to<n>take your time or
you might ruin them.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Which do you think is better?
choice_data_list: A vase would make for great interior decoration.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Then a teacup it is!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I hope I do a good job! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I try my hand at pottery with Super<n>Creek. We can't
come up with<n>anything that would be useful for
training, so we both end up making<n>teacups.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Phew... That was pretty hard work,<n>wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Having a knack for it is important, but<n>making
pottery actually uses more<n>brain power than I
expected.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
It won't turn out the way you want it<n>to if you let
your mind wander.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
But watching it slowly take shape, a<n>deep feeling of
attachment grew<n>inside me...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: As if it were my own child.
choice_data_list:
I can't wait to see how they turn out once they've
been fired in the kiln.

I can't wait to see how they turn out once they've
been fired in the kiln.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Me neither! ♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Um... Would you like to exchange<n>teacups once
they're done?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I actually made a wish on my teacup<n>while I was
making it.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I wished for all the tea you drink out<n>of it to be
delicious and relaxing.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I was. You're always working hard,<n>so I wanted to
give you some<n>comfort.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
But I'll always be here to make you<n>feel better with
more than just a cup<n>of tea! Hehe!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Several days later, Super Creek and I<n>enjoy some
tea after exchanging our<n>teacups.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It seems like she's learned<n>something valuable
from the pottery<n>class.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
It will be difficult, but trying hard is an<n>experience in
and of itself!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Let's keep giving it our all! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I try my hand at pottery with Super<n>Creek. We can't
come up with<n>anything that would be useful for
training, so we both end up making<n>vases.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Great job. Did you enjoy yourself?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
It sure was. I loved watching how<n>focused you
were. So cute. ♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
But the whole process involved more<n>detail and
patience than I expected.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
It wasn't just about gently pressing<n>the clay with
your hands. There was<n>a lot more to it.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I think it was a truly valuable<n>experience.
choice_data_list: I can't wait for them to be fired in the kiln.
I can't wait for them to be fired in the kiln.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Me neither! We should go find some<n>flowers to put
in them once they're<n>done.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
It would be lovely to decorate our<n>own rooms with
the same flowers.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
That way, we'll think of today<n>whenever we look at
them and<n>remember the fun we had! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, Super Creek and I<n>head out to
look for flowers to put in<n>our finished vases.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It seems like she's learned<n>something valuable
from the pottery<n>class.
